drmUnsupported.message: DRM / SAMPLE-AES protected media detected. This extension does not support downloading it.

dashUnsupported.message: DASH manifest detected, but video renditions could not be read. Refresh the page and try again.

dashLayoutUnsupported.message: This DASH layout is not supported. Single-period VOD with complete MP4/CMAF audio and video tracks is supported.

originalQuality.description: Quality label when resolution is not declared

cmafNeedsPlaylist.message: CMAF video track detected. It may be referenced by DASH or HLS; this track alone does not establish the complete audio/video source or download support.
cmafNeedsPlaylist.description: CMAF track without a supported manifest

footerText.message: Like this extension? Give us a Star

drmSetupHelp.message: Manage authorization for encrypted downloads. A device is already included, so you usually don’t need to import a file.

drmDeviceMissing.message: Try restoring the included device, or import a valid .wvd v2 file.

drmSaved.message: Device saved. Future downloads will use it automatically.

drmInvalidDevice.message: Import failed. Your current device is unchanged. Check that this is a valid .wvd v2 file under 256 KB and that browser storage is available.

drmBundledHint.message: No file import needed. Return to a video page to start a download.

drmCustomHint.message: Future downloads will use this device. You can restore the included one at any time.

drmStepQuality.message: Open the extension; pick a quality

drmCustomHelp.message: Import a file here if you have your own device credentials or need to replace the current device.

drmLocalNote.message: Imported locally. The file itself is not uploaded to a server.

drmFileExplanation.message: A .wvd file holds Widevine device credentials: a device certificate and private key. The extension uses them to request a playback license from the video platform and process encrypted video.

drmNotVideo.message: Choose a device file ending in .wvd. A video, an .mpd / .m3u8 URL, or a browser installer cannot be used here.

drmNoFileHelp.message: Keep using the included device. There is no need to find or import another file.

drmFaqReplaceTitle.message: When should I change the device?

drmFaqReplaceHelp.message: If the platform explicitly rejects the current device and your platform administrator or device provider supplies a compatible .wvd v2 file, you can try replacing it. Normal downloads do not require this step. A failed import leaves the current device in place.

drmFaqFailureTitle.message: Why can a download fail even with a device loaded?

drmFaqFailureHelp.message: A loaded device means its file is usable; it does not authorize every video. Your account still needs viewing access, and the platform’s license service must accept the device. Refresh the video page and play it again before retrying the download.

drmFaqPrivacyHelp.message: Device credentials stay in this browser’s local extension storage and are reused when you reopen the extension. The original file is not uploaded. During downloads, the extension uses these credentials to request authorization from the platform’s license service. You can restore the included device at any time.

drmRestored.message: Included device restored. Future downloads will use it automatically.

drmRestoreFailed.message: Could not restore the included device. Your current device is unchanged. Reload the extension and try again.
